summary.goal: Record what agents thought/decided/did and use previous trajectories as context for downstream agents, so they understand 'why' and 'how', not just 'what'.

acceptance_criteria.description: Interviewer records trajectory events (tool calls, decisions, findings) during ideation sessions
Interviewer completes trajectory with retrospective on send-to-planner
PlannerLead receives ideation retrospective as prompt context when plan sourced from ideation
PlannerLead records its own trajectory (tool calls, decisions, step rationale)
PlannerLead completes trajectory with retrospective on plan approval
Forge workers receive planning retrospective as prompt context
Testbench collects and displays forge trajectory metrics after runs
Trajectories persist to .trajectories/ directory as JSON files
Service gracefully degrades if agent-trajectories library unavailable

observations: Three distinct trajectory systems: agent-trajectories library, relay TrajectoryIntegration (subprocess-based), forge TrajectoryCapture (SQLite+SSE)
agent-trajectories library is ideal for persistent services - zero subprocess overhead, pure TypeScript, pluggable storage
Forge TrajectoryCapture must remain separate - needs real-time SSE, indexed queries, non-blocking writes
Retrospective is the built-in context bridge - distilled summary on trajectory completion
Relay SDK spawn() has no env parameter - can't pass trajectory env vars to spawned agents
concerns: FileStorage rewrites full JSON on each save - fine for low-frequency agent reasoning, not for high-frequency execution

architect.layering: Agent reasoning → agent-trajectories, Orchestration execution → forge TrajectoryCapture

decisions.question: Use relay TrajectoryIntegration or agent-trajectories library directly?
decisions.reasoning: Zero subprocess overhead, no trail CLI dependency, full type safety

decisions.question: Replace forge TrajectoryCapture with agent-trajectories?
decisions.reasoning: Forge needs SSE real-time streaming, indexed queries, non-blocking writes - different requirements

decisions.question: How to pass context between stages?
decisions.reasoning: Built-in to agent-trajectories, already distilled summary, no custom compaction needed
